howItWorks.title: From Our Kitchen to Your Table in 4 Simple Steps
howItWorks.subtitle: Getting your favorite home-cooked meals is just a few steps away.
howItWorks.step1Desc: WhatsApp us at +91-9958983578 or call directly. Tell us what you'd like—breakfast, lunch, or dinner. We'll confirm your order within minutes. Simple. No app downloads, no complicated menus.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Every morning we source fresh vegetables and ingredients from the local market. Your meal is cooked fresh in our home kitchen—never reheated, never frozen. We prepare each dish with the same care we'd use for our own family.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Pick what works for you: Morning (7-10 AM) for breakfast, Noon (12-3 PM) for lunch, or Night (7-9 PM) for dinner. We deliver to your doorstep in Panchsheel Greens, or you can pick up from our building lobby.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Receive your meal hot and fresh. Open the tiffin, serve yourself, and enjoy the taste of real home cooking. No cooking, no cleaning, no stress—just delicious, healthy food exactly when you need it.

faq.title: Got Questions? We've Got Answers.
faq.q1: Is your food really made in a home kitchen?
faq.a1: Yes! We cook in our residential apartment (A1-405, Panchsheel Greens), not a commercial kitchen. Same ingredients and care we use for our own family. We're FSSAI registered and maintain strict hygiene standards. You're welcome to visit and see for yourself!
faq.q2: How do I know the food is fresh and not reheated?
faq.a2: We cook every meal fresh on the day of delivery. No batch cooking, no freezing, no microwaving old food. What you get is food that was literally cooking 1-2 hours before it reaches you. That's why it tastes and smells like home-cooked food—because it is.
faq.q3: Can I customize my meals? I don't eat onion/garlic.
faq.a3: Absolutely! Just tell us your preferences when ordering. We regularly make meals without onion-garlic, less spicy, extra rotis, no rice, etc. Since we cook in small batches, customization is easy. Just WhatsApp us your requirements.
faq.q4: What if I'm not satisfied with a meal?
faq.a4: Your satisfaction matters to us. If you're unhappy with any meal, just call or WhatsApp us immediately. We'll either replace it or adjust your next bill. We're a small, local business that depends on happy customers, so we take feedback seriously.
faq.q5: Do you deliver outside Panchsheel Greens?
faq.a5: Currently we only deliver within Panchsheel Greens 1 to ensure food reaches you fresh and hot. We're a small operation focused on quality over quantity. If you live nearby, you can arrange pickup from our building lobby.
faq.q6: Can I try one meal before committing to a subscription?
faq.a6: Of course! Order a single meal first—no subscription required. Try our food, see if you like it, then decide. Most of our subscribers started with a one-time order and came back because they loved the taste and quality.
faq.q7: What's included in a typical lunch/dinner meal?
faq.a7: Our standard meal includes 2-3 fresh rotis, dal (usually tadka dal or rajma), seasonal sabzi (like aloo gobi, bhindi, or paneer), and rice. Portions are generous—enough to satisfy an adult's meal. You can add extra rotis, raita, or salad for a small charge.
faq.q8: Is the food suitable for weight loss or special diets?
faq.a8: Yes! We use minimal oil and cook with health in mind. Many customers order specifically for weight management or digestive issues. We can make oil-free rotis, prepare sabzi with less masala, skip rice, etc. Just tell us your dietary goals and we'll work with you.
